pipeline._comment_rag_in_label_path: The thesis specifies three things that cannot all hold. §3.10.2: the top-k documents are 'concatenated into a retrieval block prepended to the SLM prompt' — so retrieval enters the call that produces the label. §4.4.2.3: 'RAG and the cyclic agent never change the emitted label, only the action and the rationale grounding' — which is impossible if the block is prepended. H3.3: reflection must 'improve macro-F1 by at least 5 pp' on the triggered subset — which requires the label to be changeable. This flag selects which architecture is measured, and the choice is recorded in every result file. true = follow §3.10.2 literally: one call, retrieval in the prompt, label can change. Measured 2026-07-28: macro-F1 falls 0.909 -> 0.702 (-20.7 pp), because the instruction-tuning corpus contains no retrieval block and prepending one puts the prompt out of distribution. false = follow §4.4.2.3: label and confidence come from a bare in-distribution call, a second retrieval-enriched call produces the rationale and action grounding only. H3.1 then holds by construction and tests the Stage-1 gate alone, and the H3.3 macro-F1 lift is structurally zero rather than measurable.
pipeline._comment_decision_first: Emit only label+confidence on the critical path and derive the action from the deterministic policy table of Section 3.6.5, generating the rationale afterwards off-path. The full schema orders the fields label-confidence-rationale-action, so reaching the action costs the whole rationale — the term Section 5.6.1 identifies as dominant. Measured on 120 flows at Q8_0: label reproduced on 96.7%, post-floor action on 97.5%, macro-F1 0.8669 vs 0.8727, latency 4.86x lower.
